Players Committee errata-sheet slip (0 side) of [[He Is The Chosen One / He Will Bring Balance (Errata)]].

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/errata_032021.pdf Errata Sheet 2021 Spring] (Players Committee), PDF built 14 March 2021. The slip is the image embedded in the PDF (transparent areas shown white) or, for sheets that draw their text over a background image, cut from the page rendered at 300 dpi.

Edits: none.
